mapper.sql: ec.*, TRIM(e.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(e.last_name, '')) AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, TRIM(mgr.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(mgr.last_name, '')) AS manager_name, COALESCE(ec.hr_comment, ec.manager_comment) AS approver_remarks
mapper.select: SELECT FROM expense_claims ec LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = ec.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = ec.manager_id WHERE ec.company_id = #{companyId} AND (ec.manager_id = #{managerEmployeeId} OR e.reporting_manager_id = #{managerEmployeeId}) ORDER BY ec.id DESC

SELECT FROM expense_claims ec LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = ec.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = ec.manager_id WHERE ec.company_id = #{companyId} AND ec.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY ec.id DESC

SELECT FROM expense_claims ec LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = ec.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = ec.manager_id WHERE ec.id = #{id} AND ec.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_claims SET status = #{status}, manager_comment = #{comment}, manager_id = #{managerId}, manager_approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
UPDATE expense_claims SET status = #{status}, hr_comment = #{comment}, hr_approved_by = #{hrUserId}, hr_approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
UPDATE expense_claims SET status = 'REIMBURSED', reimbursed_date = CURRENT_DATE, reimbursement_ref = #{ref}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
